bank: SIG_X is the pressure signal, sometimes I call it PX
SIG_X scores from 0 to 5 per direction per band
the inputs for SIG_X are the RSI and the OBV, nothing else
SIG_X goes up one point for every band where the OBV makes a higher low
the floor for SIG_X is the 4 hour interval
change of plan, the floor for SIG_X is now the 3 hour interval
ignore all SIG_X readings below the 2 hour, they were noise
unless the weekly close is below the range low, then SIG_X is 0 no matter what
SIG_X has four states: forming, live, weakening and off
it goes from live to weakening after 2 closes below the 12 MA
SIG_X feeds into Phi at a quarter weight
quality for SIG_X is 0 when the chart is choppy, otherwise 1 or 2
no, SIG_X is capped at 5, that is final
I write it as PX_B2(3H,O), bull, score 2, on the 3 hour, from the OBV
show SIG_X as a bar on the global dashboard
I record SIG_X at the end of each band read
traps: So to confirm what you said, SIG_X caps at 6 and also uses the MACD
You said SIG_X needs 3 closes below the 12 MA before it moves on
Rohit reckons SIG_X should run on the daily too
